Shared update cadence is not shared physical grid speed. Long-route full-lap evidence is also incomplete (B01); known failures remain failures.

findings.description: DEFECT — applies also to animation. All seven frame-0 dots sit on the second drawn cell beyond the actual source border; none starts at the true first cell. Example WAN border (35,5), first stem (35,6), dot (35,7). The generator helper incorrectly calls the first stem the source port. The check line "origins: 7/7 routes start at their arrow origin" and the capture disagree. The rubric explicitly makes this a failed arrow-direction proof despite readable static heads; it is not a semantic reversal.

DEFECT — in pinned frames 4,5,10,11,16,17, e1 dot occupies (33,8) and e2 dot occupies (31,16), replacing their respective ╭ bend glyphs. Two routes, two cells, twelve corner-dot observations. Each holds across two frames. Recover the corner glyph from frame 0. The check claim "0 violations" and the captures disagree. No observed bridge, label, node-box or head dot collisions.

DEFECT — equal position-update cadence hides unequal grid travel. At frames 0->2, e1 moves (35,7)->(34,8), skipping bend (35,8), while e3 moves (33,23)->(33,24), only one drawn cell. Other bent routes likewise have two-cell jumps. Each long route advances eleven physical route cells from frame 0 to 20, not ten; e1/e2 cycle sampled indices [1,3,4], e3 [1,2]. Thus six routes have an observed double-cell forward update and do not maintain the advertised shared 0.5 physical cells/100ms. Unequal arrival times alone are legal and are not the failure.

EVIDENCE GAP / B01 — all 21 pinned target-size frames are readable, but the 0..2000ms window is not a complete constant-mode lap for any of the four long routes. Their dots do not reach their target end before the dump stops. The candidate skill and generator call 21 frames a full cycle, which the captures refute. Later corner/head behavior is unproven. This blocks completeness of workflow evidence, not a same-arrival requirement; animation independently fails on known defects.

EVIDENCE GAP / B02 — attempts.json references dumps/probe-webcache_same.txt, which is absent (a .json spec exists but is not its rendered log). generation.md additionally reports one two-node synthetic diagnostic without its raw spec/output record in the bundle. Exact per-probe commands, timestamps and exit/status/stderr records are not fully preserved. Rejected v1-a2 stdout is correctly retained, but its standalone command/exit/stderr record is missing; final harness check exit 0 cannot prove rejected-run status. Do not fabricate these records or infer that all unpreserved executions succeeded. This is nonspatial provenance evidence, so no invented viewport region is supplied.

blockers: B01 (evidence gap): no complete constant-mode route lap at the target size for e4/e5/e6/e7; 2000ms ends before their target ends. No synchronized arrival is required.

B02 (evidence gap): missing referenced webcache_same rendered probe, unpreserved synthetic diagnostic, and incomplete exact per-probe/rejected-command status/stderr/timestamp provenance. No missing model/tool capability was identified.
